data.title: 卡提希娅 · 埃格拉小镇的归还
data.description: 故乡小镇的石板路，她以流浪骑士的装扮站在熟悉又陌生的街角，光环下的表情近乡情怯；二十年殉道换来的「回来」，第一步比任何战斗都难。

data.promptProse: Cartethyia stands at the stone-paved corner of her hometown, returning in a cream high-collared tunic, blue travel jacket and practical boots. Beneath the halo, her hesitant expression moves between recognition and uncertainty before the first step home. The medium portrait follows familiar shopfronts down the street. Morning light catches her blonde braid and jacket seam, with a soft halo edge above and long paving shadows carrying the road into the distance.
